descriptions.notStarted: After making a job advancement as a Bowman, you need to find a training center that'll help you level up faster.
descriptions.inProgress: After making a job advancement as a Bowman, you should follow the arrows from Henesys that lead you to a training center. You won't be able to enter once you reach Level 20.
descriptions.completed: You found the training center for beginner Bowmen. You'll be able to receive your first set of training lessons from the trainer, Power B. Fore.
